scores.label: A
scores.note: negation warnings are fine (unexpected = not as planned); 1-2 are stiff and 2 is much longer; 3 mixes 'proficiency' with 'keeping my cool'; 4 is a near copy; 'juggle my time wisely' in 5 is odd

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 1 is a clean paraphrase; 'discovered' (2) and 'figured out' (4) are off or casual; 3 'become skilled' slightly overstates; 5 is a near copy with odd 'control my time'

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 5 changes the meaning: time management becomes multitasking and 'when things do not go as planned' becomes 'under pressure'; 1 and 3 drift from time to tasks/responsibilities; 4 is a good paraphrase
